name: Neo1
summary: Neo1 is a heavy-duty humanoid robot built around NeodraDynamics' hydraulic-electric drive technology. The manufacturer introduced the four-metre platform at the 2026 World Robot Conference and describes it as combining five-finger dexterous hands with seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arms. It is intended for heavy assembly, logistics and other dangerous or physically demanding work. Public material establishes a physical demonstration platform; commercial availability and operational deployments remain unverified.
